description: Stores what the user uses CrimeMetric for: a use case, a short description and up to 10 places, replacing any saved profile. It holds use cases and places, not names, phone numbers or other personal details. Not counted as a lookup.

places.description: Cities, metro areas or ZIP codes they care about

use_case.description: listings: Home listings or a brokerage; property_investing: Rental or investment properties; moving: Choosing where to live; research: Research, reporting or policy; app: Building an app or product; other: Something else
